signals.text: Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Help shape product direction for IDP & RPA by combining customer input, usage data, and field feedback into clear priorities.
Partner with the other builders and product strategy to turn problems into shipped features, using short written proposals and prototypes to align early.
Make judgment calls with incomplete information within your scope and own the outcome.
Communicate trade-offs and decisions clearly to stakeholders who don't live in the details the way you do.
Use AI tools across the whole loop, from specs to prototypes to production-ready code, and hold a high bar for what you ship by reviewing and improving the output rather than…
Take over Hub's fleet propagation mechanism from the team building its first version, and make it work for access, secrets, tenants, licences and custom roles
Write short design documents for foundational changes, get them reviewed by the teams that depend on them, and turn them into tested, shipped code
Design how Hub behaves when things go wrong: offline clusters, partial failures, Hub outages, and clusters being adopted or detached
Build the path from clusters back to Hub, starting with deployment inventory, health, audit records and licence status
Design Hub's first event and webhook mechanism, so admins and agents can react to changes instead of polling for them
